summary: Implemented terminal window title support, not run or tested. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) variant in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 sequence "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and a Control.title(title) classmethod that strips non-printable characters; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added entry. No tests were added, despite the spec's checklist. Nothing is committed.
